ledger.note: By 920 BC: Sam'al is a kingdom. The page says it 'had become a kingdom' 'by the 920 BC' (its wording), with Zincirli as capital; the infobox says 1200 BC and the alternative view makes Hayyanu the founder with Ahabbu of Siri'laya following in 854 BC. The page does not reconcile them; the 920 date is the body text's.

ledger.note: 825 BC: Assyria brings Sam'al under its sway. 'Assyrians won over Denyen and Sam'al in 825 BC' (page); Shalmaneser III also listed Ya'udi as a satellite, and the page says Sam'al was independent 'after the death of Shalmaneser III' without a year. The vassalage runs to the 717 occupation as a bridge at the gap.

sources.title: Sam'al
sources.note: Infobox 1200-609 BC with Zincirli coordinates; kingdom by 920 BC; Hayyanu 859/853; Assyria won over Sam'al 825; occupation by Sargon II in 717; no area, no dynasty dates.

notes: Cliopatria has no Sam'al; the neo-hittite-states hull contains it (Cliopatria's Neo-Hittite shapes and the Neo-Assyrian -800 shape cover Zincirli), so the renderer should draw Sam'al as a sub-state of that hull or drop it, and me-02 should decide. The page's own dates disagree: infobox 1200-609 BC, body 'by 920 BC' and 717 BC; the body is used. Annexation of Ya'udi (the Ya'udi kingdom, founder Gabbar) is undated on the page and not drawn, nor are the gains from Carchemish, Quwe and Adana. 'Part of Yamhad' early in the second millennium is 'thought', undated, not drawn. Ya'udi and Denyen (Que) need dossiers from another group. Page budget: one page.
